batch: P5 continued: minimum 20 NEW January 2027 eligible event instances
notes: User's minimum is 20 eligible NEW event occurrences, NOT 20 websites. Research continued past 20 websites.

One official 2027 date (Colonia Bears 22 Jan) and one calendar-specific secondary 2027 date (Lord Clyde 2 Jan); the other instances derive from official recurring weekly/monthly schedules and require future reconfirmation.
Colonia Bears official website says 22 Jan. Third-party sources Pinksider and gay-location say 15 Jan. Follow primary source; start time intentionally left blank because third-party timings disagree.
The Locker Room Lads for Dads is NOT treated as weekly; different archive dates and 'every second Wednesday' description conflict, so no Lads for Dads events added.
Mixed access sessions such as Pipeworks FLUID, Paradise Dresden Thursday/Saturday, Acqua Biphoria Thursday and Die Insel Sweet Dreams are excluded.
Bunker London has 57 existing January events; no duplicates added.
Some auditor rows refer to general gay nightlife with no darkroom; these are checked but not inserted.
